item.title: Windows POS 1.0.41+60
item.description:
Windows POS 1.0.41+60
- Add Pay & Pickup to the unconfirmed inventory list, using the existing storage correction behavior: zero the balance, set pickup to the Due Date, and mark the location with [fix]. Confirm the correction before applying; it does not collect a payment transaction. - Keep corrected orders separate from physically scanned orders, and verify Firebase and local backup updates before removing them from the remaining list. - Print unconfirmed orders and scanned exceptions separately on the invoice printer. Preview includes order number, customer, location, quantity, balance, and exception details without truncating long values. - Allow staff to edit storage locations in Dropoff. Prefill the current location and preserve the rack date when only the location changes. Apply the edit, then use the existing order Save button. Existing picked-up-order restrictions remain. - Retain all inventory, native speech, location editing, receipt, and summary improvements from 1.0.41+57.
